notes:
I found no toddler underwater basket weaving anywhere in Halton Hills. The basket-weaving classes that came up were adult or older-child workshops, mostly in other places. The closest real toddler activity from an operator's own page is the town's Parent & Tot swim lessons.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Parent & Tot swim lessons (Parent and Tot 1/2/3), Acton Indoor Pool, Town of Halton Hills",
      "age_fit": "4 months to 3 years old, with a parent",
      "when": "Fall session Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026 (30-minute lessons); day and time of the Parent & Tot class not seen",
      "price": "$86.22 for 9 lessons",
      "source_name": "Town of Halton Hills"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Age fit:** 
The town's level guide puts children aged 4 months to 3 years who are ready to enjoy the water with a parent in Parent & Tot 1/2/3.

- **Fall dates and price:** 
The Acton fall schedule runs Saturday October 3 to Thursday December 3, 2026. Parent & Tot to Swimmer 3 is $86.22 for 9 lessons of 30 minutes.

- **Gellert option:** 
Gellert Community Centre in Georgetown runs fall evening and weekend lessons from Saturday, October 3 to Monday, December 7, 2026.
 I didn't find a Parent & Tot day or time there.
- **Missing details:** I didn't see a Parent & Tot day or time for fall, or a registration date, so I've left them out.
- **Source caveat:** The swim page's metadata was marked as old. It still showed Fall 2026 content, but it's worth checking against the live page.
